paragraphs: In the morning, scan leads and social media and decide which story to pursue. Around noon, conduct interviews, verify sources, and cross-check every fact. In the afternoon, write the article and debate angles and wording with the editor. Before leaving, review audience data and prepare follow-up reporting or analysis for the next day.
